title: Voice I/O check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test for core-ar2's note ends, track mutes and DIN MIDI out on the Analog Rytm MKII, on screen. BD VIO (slot 44, BD voice) plays as BD CLASSIC and counts core_voice_trigged and core_voice_released per block; on each release its engine sends a DIN note-off from the audio interrupt. PLAYMODE shows or hides a bar: T trigs, R releases, C cuts, M the track mutes (core_track_mutes, hex), D DIN sends from the UI task as sent/refused, I those from the engine, U core_midi_din_up. QPER toggles the BD track's mute through core_set_track_mutes; FLTR sends a DIN note-on on press and a note-off on release.
